correctness.rationale: PASS: An independent all-face computation generated 254475 augmented independent faces of Q5. The inspected parity-first greedy Morse matching has 127231 pairs and only one critical 0-cell, one 5-cell, and ten 7-cells; independent enumeration of every Hasse cover and topological sorting visited all 254474 nonempty faces and verified acyclicity. This is an exhaustive finite proof certificate conditional on the transparent arithmetic/enumeration algorithms, not sampling. With no adjacent critical dimensions all integral Morse cellular boundaries vanish. Combinatorial Alexander duality on 32 vertices maps cohomology degree 7 to theta degree 22 and degree 5 to 24; UCT applies because homology is free. Nontrivial attaching maps between dimensions 5 and 7 are not ruled out, so no homotopy wedge claimed.
